objective: Give people who already benefit from LazyingArt's public repositories a clear, low-pressure sponsorship path without turning sponsorship into a service promise.

source_need.evidence: The public profile was active and accepted custom amounts, but the authenticated Sponsors listing had zero published monthly tiers and zero published one-time tiers.
source_need.policy: Sponsorship is optional support for public work. It is not a fixed-scope service, product order, priority queue, private repository entitlement, investment, or revenue until a payment is actually received.

fit.reason: These public projects already have owner-visible attention or strong technical proof and already expose GitHub Sponsors through repository funding configuration.
fit.claim_boundary: Repository stars, views, clones, replies, and a visible Sponsor button are attention only. They do not prove a sponsor, payment, payout, customer, or revenue.

tiers.description: Help maintain LazyingArt's open-source documentation, tests, and public releases. This is sponsorship, with no guaranteed support, private access, or specific deliverable.
A simple thank-you when a LazyingArt tool or guide saves you time. This is sponsorship, with no service, priority support, private access, or specific deliverable.
Back continued maintenance of LazyingArt's research, local-first, multilingual, and learning tools. This is sponsorship, with no promised feature, private service, or guaranteed response.

public_path.verification: The public GraphQL listing returned all three published tiers, and anonymous HTML returned the monthly and one-time tier copy.
